Hình thức số nhiều của bánh sandwich.

sentences.en: Martha prepared grilled cheese sandwiches for our lunch.

sentences.en: Other choices include hot dogs, hamburgers, sausage and peppers, pulled pork sandwiches and stuffed pretzels.
